body.condition: For every type \(r\), every root \(s\) in \(d_r\) has law \(\operatorname{Pois}(\alpha_{rs})\) with \(\alpha_{rs}>0\), while every non-root \(s\) has conditional kernel \(\operatorname{Pois}(\lambda_{rs,\theta})\) with \(\lambda_{rs,\theta}(v)=\alpha_{rs}+\sum_{k\in\operatorname{pa}_{d_r}(s)}b_{rsk}v_k^{q_{sk}}\) and strictly positive root and declared-edge coefficients.

novel.justification: This paper maintains a stricter Poisson-root positive-polynomial Poisson-DAG subclass as a transparent synthetic and prospective-design benchmark. Source-node Poissonity is imposed here; the broader CPCM framework permits arbitrary source-node laws.
